cohort: This study describes a single pregnant patient with a large, symptomatic multiple uterine myomas causing intestinal obstruction.
finding: This case demonstrates the safety of myomectomy during pregnancy in special circumstances such as intestinal obstruction caused by external compression by a big fibroid.
mod_finding: The patient was delivered by Caesarian hysterectomy at term due to multiple myomas occupying the lower segment with placenta accrete and uncontrolled blood loss.
